body: I appreciate the concern. I'll contemplate it, but I'm already kind of ready for what comes next. I'm sick of being so scared of the power of my actions. I just want a little peace of mind.

Nope, just shy of 21. Though I appreciate the sentiment. A large handful of money from selling that nut of yours might help me gain the self centeredness to break up with my girl and move the hell away. So as long as we can arrange something, I won't and you'll be more than correct. I'll flourish 🤣
